segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers mostly report the paste is gentle enough for regular or occasional use without irritation, and several specifically praise it for calming breakouts without stinging or redness.
segments.dry: The two reviewers with dry or dry, acne-prone skin report the paste dried out active breakouts without over-drying the rest of their face, though one limits use to weekly rather than daily because her skin is naturally dry.

concerns.blemishes: The large majority of reviewers report the paste reduces breakouts, blackheads, or cystic acne, often within days to a few weeks, whether used as a cleanser, mask, or overnight spot treatment; a smaller number report it did not help or even triggered new breakouts when used as a daily face wash.
concerns.dehydration: Many reviewers highlight, often with surprise, that the paste treats acne without leaving skin feeling dry, tight, or stripped, though a few reviewers with naturally dry skin limit use to avoid over-drying.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers report reduced redness around blemishes with continued use, describing calmer, less inflamed-looking skin.
concerns.spots: A couple of reviewers mention a general improvement in glow or a few dark spots fading, though this is not the product's main reported effect and most reviews focus on active breakouts rather than lingering marks.

aspects.libelle: Versatile 3-in-1 use as cleanser, mask, and spot treatment
Doesn't lather or foam much, more of a paste
Stays wet rather than fully drying when left on overnight
Can transfer onto and bleach pillowcases or towels

extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] As someone who has struggled with acne for 10+ years, I'm always looking for something to help with my inevitable breakouts. I was excited to test this cleansing paste out, as it's marketed as a cleanser, mask, and treatment all in one. As a cleanser, it is smooth and slippery, but doesn't foam much and it leaves skin feeling a bit dry. As a mask, it goes on smoothly, but never fully dries - it stays as a paste. I was using it as a spot treatment for a while and it would end up on my pillowcase in the morning. As for effectiveness, it didn't dry up my active breakouts as much as I wanted it to. It maybe took the redness down slightly. If your skin reacts well to salicylic acid, this could be a great product for you.

extraits.titre: Good only for spot treatment. Not as a wash.
extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] It started out great. Then I started seeing pimples. This product did not work for my skin. It actually made me breakout. Good for pimple spot treatment. But I would not use it for my whole face.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I like this acne paste. I haven't tried one before so this is my first time. It's such a cool thing to have a 3 in 1 as it's a cleanser, mask and spot treatment. The lather is nice and creamy when you use it. I like how it felt on my skin and how I was able to see some results after using it for awhile. It helped me clear up some blackheads

extraits.titre: Good product but a little pricey
extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] It's Gentle on my sensitive skin and helped reduce breakouts over time (although I am on acne medication as well). I liked the creamy texture, no scent, and clean ingredients. The packaging is simple and travel-friendly. Took off one star because it's a bit pricey for the size, but overall worth trying.

I have trouble with cystic acne sometimes and have never had anything work even remotely close as this. I only used it as an overnight "mask," I use that lightly as I only used it the cystic pimple. I was blown away how much it decreased and the pain subsided after the first night. By the end of night 3, it was completely gone. They usually last for nearly 2 weeks! So I would recommend this product for cystic acne alone. I'm sure it works great for everything else, but I don't really have acne besides when I get these. Very glad I was able to receive this product complementary. It's worth every penny though.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I tend to have dry acne prone skin and I love this face wash . The texture is thick and does bubble slightly. It can be used as a mask or spot treatment as well as a face wash . The scent is a natural wet clay scent that I got used to very quickly . It didn't dry out my skin and prevented new break out . I will be repurchasing this product I love the versatility of it .

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've had such a good experience with this cleansing paste. Sometimes I get hormonal breakouts and this helped dry them out without making my skin feel super dry. It's not something I would use daily because my skin is more on the dry side naturally but overall, really great product. Happy to have gotten the chance to try it!
